claim: localhost (getlocalhost.app) uses a project-sidebar IA: a Project is a folder containing Services (one long-running command each); selecting a Project's Service shows its log, and the window combines service list + merged log + a global Ports view.

claim: localhost models service state as exactly six named states — Stopped, Starting, Running, Stopping, Exited, Failed — with 'Running' defined as port accepts connections (or ~1.5s alive), and Failed surfaces the reason plus last log lines inline.
verbatim_quote: Failed | Ended on its own with an error, or couldn't start. The reason and the last lines of output are shown.
quote: Failed | Ended on its own with an error, or couldn't start. The reason and the last lines of output are shown.

claim: localhost's color discipline: one accent color for the brand, green/orange/red/grey reserved exclusively for Service State, plus a stable per-Service color used as a log prefix tag.

claim: localhost primary actions: Start/Restart on a selected service (Cmd-R), Stop (Cmd-.), and project-level Start All / Stop All (Shift-Cmd-R / Shift-Cmd-.) that honor dependency order; secondary actions live in menus and a Cmd-K command palette.
verbatim_quote: Select a Service and press ⌘R to start (or restart) it, ⌘. to stop it. ⇧⌘R starts every Service of the Project in dependency order, ⇧⌘. stops them all.
